## Episode Thesis

This is a personal-finance episode of Rika Tillsammans with behavioural scientist Moa Diseborn. It covers how wealthy families should talk to their children about money, inheritance, early inheritance and fairness between siblings. They cite research that about 70% of wealth transfers fail, mostly because trust and communication break down, and they discuss forum stories about secret gifts, unequal hobby costs and the timing of inheritance. There is no discussion of stocks or market views; the only companies named appear in ads or as passing references.
